brief:
A political analyst told Shehab Wire that Israel's penetration into central Gaza represents a failed political operation serving Prime Minister Netanyahu's agenda. The analyst characterized the incursion as an attempt to impose new realities on the ground and prevent the return of residents to their homes.

The operation also aims to obstruct any independent Palestinian administration, according to the assessment. The characterization reflects criticism of Israeli military strategy in Gaza as driven by political rather than security objectives.
dek: A political analyst told Shehab Wire that Israel's penetration into central Gaza represents a failed political operation serving Prime Minister Netanyahu's agenda.
title: Political analyst calls Israeli Gaza incursion politically failed operation
